items.title: CRM Manager - Sportsbook Global Promotions
items.description: Excellent opportunity to join Betsson Group as our new CRM Global Promotions Manager - Sportsbook THE WOW Betsson Group is seeking a self-driven and detail-oriented CRM expert with a "can-do" attitude to join our Global CRM & Engagement department. This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of an amazing team of CRM and sports enthusiasts. In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the successful end-to-end delivery of Sportsbook Global Promotions designed to engage and entertain the group’s wider customer base beyond the game play. In this role you are responsible for promotions such as The Million, Sportsbook Leaderboards, and prize draws, all with big headline prizes aimed to offer an attractive ‘shop window’ to achieve brand loyalty. To be successful in this role, you need a strong understanding of various sports, competitions, and leagues both globally and in Betsson’s key markets, along with a genuine passion for sports to understand what drives and motivates customers. THE CHALLENGE: You will definitely be busy! Here is a taste of what you will be involved with: Sportsbook Promotions Calendar: Design the CRM global promotions calendar, focusing on above-the-line, open-to-all, onsite campaigns centred around major global and local sporting events. Price Boosts: Ensure a competitive Price Boost offering on popular global and local sports, competitions & leagues. Project Management: Use JIRA to efficiently manage global promotions projects and tasks, and to maintain effective communications with all teams and relevant stakeholders. Engagement: Boost campaign participation by experimenting with creatives, copy, layouts, channels, reward types, and reward values. CRM Budget & Optimisation: Manage the CRM spend budget for global promotions, collaborating with CRM Analytics to continuously fine-tune campaigns to achieve improved customer retention and performance. Leadership: Lead a team of CRM Coordinators responsible for flawlessly executing global promotions across all CRM channels. Motivate and guide the team by setting clear goals and objectives, addressing knowledge gaps, and arranging CRM training as needed. Quality Assurance: Ensure that all global promotions are executed on-brand with high quality output, whilst maintaining Betsson Groups high standards for competition fairness and integrity. Localisation & Compliance: Optimise CRM plans to be relevant and localised for each market and collaborate with local market teams to understand key events, competitor activity, regulatory requirements, limitations, and local trends. When required, run highly localised onsite promotions in collaboration with a local market. Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for campaign and process improvement within your team and the broader department, quantify their impact, and drive implementation. Cross-Team Collaboration: Keep acquisition and regional teams informed about big headline promotions suitable for external marketing channels. Work closely with the Support team to optimise campaign customer journeys to reduce contact-drivers. Stakeholder Reporting: Provide reporting to senior stakeholders on the success of Sportsbook global promotions, demonstrating a deep understanding of what motivates Sportsbook customers. CRM & VIP Analytics: Collaborate with our analytics team to establish cost projections and success metrics for global Sportsbook promotions. Trading Teams: Collaborate with the trading team to set competitive prices for Price Boost offering. Local Sportsbook Managers: Work closely with the local Sportsbook Managers to understand key sports events, leagues, and competitions that will be the key activity drivers in their market. CRM Projects & Solutions: Offer feedback on enhancements to CRM tools and new player reward types and features. Conduct testing for new CRM product releases. Regions: Collaborate with local copywriters to ensure full localisation of global promotions material, transforming global mechanics into local messages. Design & Branding: Work with the branding and design team on the propositions of promotions, to ensure creative output in line with promotional goals. YOU ARE GOOD AT: Minimum of 4 years’ CRM experience, ideally from a similar role in the igaming industry. Experience from working in a multi-brand and/or multi-market environment. Proven people management experience. Good understanding of player bonuses and incentives. Excellent ability to interpret CRM data and derive actionable insights. Proficiency in CRM tools and email marketing platforms, ideally from Salesforce or Xtremepush. Strong understanding of various sports, competitions, and leagues both globally and in Betsson’s key markets, along with a genuine passion for sports to understand what drives and motivates customers. Great project management skills, enabling you to handle multiple campaigns and tasks concurrently. Results-driven and customer-focused mindset. Excellent written and verbal skills in English and Spanish. WHAT IS IN IT FOR ME? Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you’re a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you’ll fit right in. We offer numerous challenges where your skills will be put to good use! We encourage innovation, independence and celebrate success where you will be part of multi-cultural and diverse company, with people from all over the world. CHALLENGE ACCEPTED? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team The Design team at Raisin brings together product designers and brand & marketing designers. We are united by a shared belief in respect, creativity, and our purpose to give people financial peace of mind. As our Digital Brand Designer, you'll join the Brand & Acquisition team. We shape how Raisin looks, moves, and feels across every market we operate in: paid and organic social, our websites, product launches, and campaigns. You'll report to the Head of Brand and Marketing Design and work integrated with the US Marketing team. Your main focus is conversion: designing and testing the landing pages, web journeys, and creative that turn interest into sign-ups. You'll also support broader marketing initiatives across paid social, web, and email, so Raisin feels consistent across the funnel. Your Responsibilities Conversion-Driven Web Design: Design, test, and optimize high-converting landing pages, reusable UI components, and end-to-end user journeys that elevate the brand and drive growth, while governing overall website design standards and brand alignment. Data-Informed Experimentation & Testing: Partner with Marketing to turn hypotheses into A/B and multivariate tests, from concept to shipped variant, and iterate based on the results, using funnel analytics, heatmaps, test results, and customer insights to find friction and decide what to test next. Creative Production: Produce static and animated creative, from hero assets to fast, iterative test variations within our brand design. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is looking for a Staff+ Software Engineer to work on the vector search infrastructure behind Claude. Retrieval is how Claude learns about the world. Web search across claude.ai, the API and agentic surfaces, memory across conversations, and the reinforcement learning workloads that train our next models all depend on fast, cheap, high-recall nearest-neighbor search over billions of vectors. You'll join a small team responsible for the vector database layer that serves Claude's retrieval workloads: its architecture, performance, scalability and cost. This is a foundational role. The team is small, core architectural decisions are still open, and the engineers who join now will shape how the system evolves. The role sits in our Databases organization and works day to day with the Search Platform team, which owns web search indexing, retrieval and serving, and the Memory & Search team, which owns search and memory inside claude.ai. We're looking for someone who has built vector or search systems that ran in production, at scale, with real users and a real on-call. You'll be hands-on in the code, and you'll also be the person deciding how the pieces fit together. Key responsibilities Own the core of Anthropic's vector database layer: index structures, storage layout, query execution and the serving layer Own production readiness - benchmarking against exact search, capacity planning, onboarding new workloads, and the operational tooling to run it at scale Drive the recall, latency and cost trade-offs - quantization, filtered search, index build and refresh strategy, and how compute and storage are separated and scaled Scale throughput by an order of magnitude as research and training demand grows, and work out whether the bottleneck is architecture, hardware or engineering bandwidth Extend the retrieval stack toward hybrid retrieval - lexical search and fused ranking alongside vector search Set the evaluation methodology for the system - recall targets, latency objectives, cost per query, and the regression detection that keeps them honest Set technical direction for a growing team - lead design reviews, make architectural decisions others build on, and mentor the engineers joining the effort Share the on-call for the systems you own Minimum qualifications Direct experience building a vector database or approximate nearest-neighbor search system that ran in production at scale Deep knowledge of ANN index structures (graph-based, clustering-based or disk-resident approaches), vector quantization and filtered search Experience with search relevance and ranking Strong systems programming skills in a language such as Rust, C++ or Go, including performance-critical and memory-intensive code Experience designing and operating large-scale distributed storage or serving systems with strict latency and reliability requirements A track record of independently scoping and delivering ambiguous, multi-quarter technical projects Strong written and verbal communication, with experience driving alignment across teams with different priorities Interest in AI safety and Anthropic's mission Preferred qualifications Experience with object-storage-backed or disaggregated compute and storage database designs Experience building or operating full-text search engines (inverted indexes, BM25) or hybrid retrieval systems Familiarity with embedding models and the retrieval demands of LLM training and inference Experience using GPUs or other accelerators for index build or search Prior experience as a technical lead on a database or search infrastructure team The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. We are training the models behind our agents in Codex, ChatGPT, the API, and other frontier products: persistent, proactive intelligence that can operate computers, collaborate with people and other agents, and expand what people and organizations can imagine, attempt, and achieve. You will help train models that can navigate browsers and desktops, use tools and applications, reason through complex workflows, collaborate with users and other agents, and complete long-horizon tasks with reliability and judgment. This work sits at the intersection of frontier model training, product behavior, evaluation, and systems engineering, and will directly shape the computer-use capabilities shipped in OpenAI’s next generation of agents. Currently, our models are the best in the world at this behavior! You will work with researchers, engineers, product teams, infrastructure teams, and safety/alignment partners to decide what should go into major model runs, measure whether it worked, and ship improvements into products used by real people. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and our sales and solutions teams, and you'll bring what you learn from customer-facing work back to the people building the products. Because a demo is frequently someone's first impression of what our models can and can't do, accuracy and honesty matter as much as polish. Success in this role looks like customer-facing teams demonstrating new capabilities sooner and with more confidence, recurring requests becoming reusable assets rather than one-off projects, and field insights shaping product and launch-readiness decisions. patterns from customer-facing work into product feedback, launch-readiness priorities, and systemic improvements with Product and Engineering Define and raise the bar for demo quality across accuracy, safety, reliability, usability, and adoption Decide when a customer need calls for a bespoke build and when it should become a shared capability You may be a good fit if you have Proficiency in Python About the Role We’re looking for a Product Reliability Engineer to own reliability engineering for advanced IT hardware, from printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) through compute and networking trays, systems, and fully integrated racks. You’ll translate operating conditions and service-life goals into reliability requirements, design and execute qualification tests, and drive failure analysis and corrective-action verification from development through production and field deployment. Use failure modes and effects analysis (DFMEA or FMEA) and physics of failure to prioritize risks and recommend design improvements. Own component de-rating guidelines and guidance. - Own reliability qualification plans from new product introduction through production, defining test coverage, representative configurations, sample sizes, stress conditions, duration, pass/fail criteria, and exit evidence at each assembly level. - Develop and execute accelerated life and environmental tests, including temperature cycling, humidity exposure, power cycling, shock, vibration, and transport testing. items.title: Mechanical Engineer, PCBA Test Infrastructure, Robotics
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer for a senior individual-contributor role leading printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) test fixtures and infrastructure for advanced robotic systems. You will independently turn evolving requirements into working fixtures, make technical tradeoffs, and own delivery from concept and detailed design through fabrication, validation, deployment, and reliable operation. This role combines development-lab work with deployment at contract manufacturers. You will build precision mechanical systems for board programming, functional test, and characterization, including board nests, probe plates, connector interfaces, alignment features, clamps, enclosures, and thermal interfaces. You will partner with electrical, firmware, software, manufacturing, and reliability teams to make fixtures repeatable, protective of delicate assemblies, and maintainable as board designs evolve. This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and requires in-person presence 4 days a week. Travel to contract-manufacturer sites is part of the role, with timing based on build and deployment needs. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Own the mechanical architecture of PCBA test stations, including frames, board nests, datum schemes, access, guarding, ergonomics, and serviceability. - Design probe and bed-of-nails fixtures, connector-mating mechanisms, board supports, clamps, and interchangeable tooling for programming, functional test, and characterization. - Use first-principles analysis and simulation to assess stiffness, probe and insertion forces, board deflection, tolerance stacks, thermal growth, and fixture life; validate key predictions on hardware. - Develop locating and compliance features that accommodate board and assembly variation, protect components and solder joints, and preserve contact repeatability across loading cycles and board revisions. - Partner with electrical engineers on test-point access, probe selection, connector engagement, ESD provisions, cable routing, cooling, and interlocks; define motion and sequencing constraints with software and controls partners. - Build, assemble, instrument, and debug fixtures in the lab. Establish acceptance checks for alignment, force, board strain where needed, contact repeatability, and cycle life; separate fixture problems from board failures. - Design safe loading, pinch-point protection, hard stops, and operator access for manual or actuated fixtures. Make wear components easy to inspect, clean, and replace. - Manage fabrication partners and component vendors. Release CAD, drawings, bills of materials, tolerance analyses, assembly instructions, inspection plans, and maintenance procedures. - Own fixture deployment and acceptance at contract manufacturers, including assembly and alignment checks, correlation with lab fixtures, operator training, and troubleshooting. Support replication, board-revision changes, and maintenance through released documentation. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have strong mechanical intuition for precision interfaces, load paths, compliance, tolerances, and the behavior of delicate electronic assemblies. - Move readily between analysis, CAD, vendor collaboration, and hands-on assembly and debugging. - Care about repeatable contact, controlled forces, operator usability, and equipment that others can maintain. - Take ownership from concept through reliable daily operation, adapting fixtures to evolving boards and communicating clearly across electrical, software, manufacturing, and operations teams. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Demonstrated ability to independently deliver significant precision-fixture or equipment projects from ambiguous requirements through detailed design, fabrication, validation, and sustained use. - Strong 3D CAD and released-drawing capability, including complete fabrication and assembly packages, bills of materials, and revision control. - Strong fundamentals in GD&T, tolerance analysis, locating schemes, stiffness, compliance, contact forces, and load paths. - Hands-on ability to work with fabrication partners, assemble and measure fixtures, diagnose failures, and iterate hardware in a lab or manufacturing environment. - Ability to define and execute fixture acceptance checks for alignment, force, repeatability, wear, and safe operation, using evidence to distinguish fixture problems from product variation. - Ability to communicate interfaces and tradeoffs across electrical, software, manufacturing, and operations teams and support deployment and troubleshooting at contract manufacturers. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - Prior PCBA test-fixture experience with board nests, probe or bed-of-nails fixtures, connector mating, and protection of delicate electronic assemblies. - Experience with ESD-aware tooling, thermal interfaces, actuated fixtures, interlocks, or structural and thermal simulation. - Experience with NX, SolidWorks, Creo, or equivalent tools; robotics hardware; or fixture replication and new-product builds at contract manufacturers. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - Deliver a reusable PCBA fixture that meets agreed alignment, contact, board-support, and loading requirements, with demonstrated repeatability and protection of the assembly under test. - Validate fixture wear and cycle life, identify sources of intermittent contact or board loading, and improve contact-related failures, changeover time, and serviceability against agreed targets. - Deploy and accept the fixture at a contract manufacturer with released CAD, drawings, inspection checks, assembly instructions, spare-parts information, and maintenance procedures that enable others to reproduce and sustain it. items.description: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. The Role Are you a builder who has already shipped AI that changed how a business runs? Fanatics wants you. We're hiring full-time Applied AI Engineers to join a small, senior team that sits at the center of how Fanatics transforms itself with AI. Our goal is simple and ambitious: make Fanatics a faster, more automated company. Each Applied AI Engineer works like a tiger team: embed with a business function, find its biggest bottlenecks, replace slow, manual work with AI agents and workflows that actually run in production, then move on to the next challenge. This is a doer's role, not an advisory one. You'll own problems end to end: define them, design the solution, build it, prove it works, and drive adoption. You'll have real autonomy, executive visibility, and a direct line to leadership, with joint reporting to the CFO and Corporate AI Transformation Lead. We're looking for someone with prior experience doing applied AI work at a startup or fast-growing company, who is used to moving quickly with limited resources and is ready to bring that pace to a global brand. What You'll Do • Embed within corporate functions across the business, find the workflows where AI can remove the most manual effort or unlock the most growth, fix them, then rotate to the next function. • Design, build, and deploy production-grade agents and agentic workflows using frontier models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) and the modern agent stack: MCP servers, agent SDKs, orchestration tools, browser and computer use, and evals. • Move fast: take a high-impact use case from concept to working solution in weeks, not quarters, and prove it with measurable results. • Think in systems and bias toward solving the problem, not toward building for its own sake. Sometimes the right answer is a custom agent; sometimes it's configuring an existing tool. • Partner with business leaders to be accountable for outcomes, and help them rethink how their teams operate in an AI-first way. • Call balls and strikes: pressure-test whether a problem is worth automating, what "good" looks like, and how to measure ROI. • Help set the bar for AI across the company, including tool evaluation, security and InfoSec coordination, governance, and best practices. • Spread the practice: document and showcase wins, coach colleagues, and help build a company culture that automates by default. What We're Looking For • 3+ years of experience in applied AI or software engineering, including time at a startup or fast-growing company where you shipped AI-powered products or automations to real users. • A track record of building and deploying custom agents or agentic workflows with frontier LLMs that solved real business problems, not just prototypes. • Fluency with the modern AI stack: LLM APIs, MCP, agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG, and evaluation methods. • Strong coding skills (Python preferred) and the judgment to pick the right tool for the job, including buying or configuring instead of building. • Comfort operating independently in ambiguity, with a high bar for speed, ownership, and follow-through. • A strategic mindset paired with a "get it done" attitude; you can tell the difference between a cool demo and a business outcome. • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to earn trust and drive change with senior business leaders. • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience welcome. • Bonus points if you're a fan of sports, collectibles, or fandom culture (because we're a little obsessed). Why You'll Love It Here • Real ownership of high-visibility problems, with exposure to every part of Fanatics and direct access to senior leadership. • A chance to be part of a small, hand-picked team shaping how a global sports and collectibles company becomes AI-first. • Backing for your work: dedicated headcount, budget, and executive sponsorship to get things done. • Competitive salary and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. • 401(k) plan with company match. • Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and parental leave. • Wellness benefits and a learning & development stipend. • NYC office with daily in-person collaboration. • Employee discount on Fanatics products and (yes) some sweet Fanatics swag. Final Word If you've built AI that moved a business and you're ready to do it at global scale, let's talk. This is where the doers build. The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here .

items.title: Evaluation Engineer, Applied AI
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE This is a chance to build the frontier LLM evals that shape the next generations of flagship models. Could a model design a computer chip, or find the backdoor an attacker left in a network? Public benchmarks can't tell us, as they're generally not a good measure of real work. As an Evaluation Engineer, you'll own evals from start to finish. You'll run workshops with customers, industry experts and our customer-facing teams to understand their most important industry use cases (e.g., an engineer updating a part in CAD software), and help decide which are worth building first. You'll also look beyond today's use cases and design moonshot evals for work no model can do yet, so Mistral gets there first. Then you'll turn each one into a benchmark, often one where an agent has to do the work inside real software. You'll source the data, decide how to score it, and run it on every new Mistral model and on competitor models. When our models fall short, you'll work with the post-training teams to close the gap. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join a small, dedicated growth and experimentation team within Krak, focused on accelerating acquisition, activation, engagement and trading activity across the Krak app. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: the majority of your work will be in React Native, supported by enough backend capability to take an experiment from idea to live without waiting on another team. Rather than executing against a rigid roadmap, you’ll work closely with Product on a continuous pipeline of fast, lightweight experiments, owning each one from hypothesis through implementation, launch, measurement and iteration. The mandate is simple: find the highest-leverage opportunities to grow users and revenue, prove what works, and scale the winners – with direct, measurable impact on how millions of customers discover and use Kraken’s products. The opportunity - Build and ship consumer-facing features quickly in React Native and TypeScript, favouring small, high-velocity experiments over long-running projects. - Own experiments end-to-end – hypothesis, design, build, launch, measurement and iteration – using platforms such as Statsig to test globally or within specific markets. - Improve onboarding, activation and feature discovery to drive conversion, engagement and trading revenue, iterating rapidly on features that are already live. - Build viral acquisition features and value-add growth features on top of Krak’s existing product offering. - Contribute to backend services and APIs wherever an experiment requires it, so you can ship across the stack without being blocked. Our backend is primarily Rust; prior Rust experience is not expected, but enthusiasm for picking it up is. - Read your own results, including trade-offs between conversion gains and other metrics, and decide whether to scale, iterate or kill – driving technical decisions autonomously amid evolving priorities and limited upfront planning. What you bring - 6+ years of software development experience building and shipping large-scale, consumer-facing applications. Strong, hands-on React and React Native experience is essential. - Demonstrated experience running growth experiments at consumer-facing businesses, with measurable impact on conversion, activation, retention or revenue. This is a consumer growth role, so B2B or platform-only backgrounds are not a fit. - Working backend proficiency: you can design and implement services and APIs yourself. We care about backend fundamentals rather than any particular language, and you should be open to working in Rust. - Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, with hands-on experience across APIs, WebSockets and real-time systems, mobile performance, testing, and modern development workflows. - Practical experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests – feature flags, statistical significance, product analytics, funnel and cohort data – with the judgement to act decisively on what the results show. - End-to-end ownership of product features and a strong product engineering mindset, with the initiative and adaptability to operate with minimal direction amid ambiguity and frequently changing priorities. Nice to haves - Customer-facing product experience within fintech, digital banking, payments, trading or crypto. - Hands-on experience with Statsig or a comparable experimentation platform, including regional and global rollouts. - Rust experience, given our backend stack. - SQL and self-serve analytics, so you can pull and interrogate your own data. - AI fluency. Familiarity with how AI tools and patterns have fundamentally shifted your development workflow and problem-solving approach. - Native mobile development (iOS/Android), distributed systems or microservices, or engineering within a hyperscaling consumer technology organisation. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE The Music team owns music and sound effects end to end at ElevenLabs. Five new research engineers have just joined the music research group, and models for stem separation and MIDI transcription are in progress. You’ll join as a Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean.
